Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

Whom did Jesus teach his disciples to pray to?

Jesus taught his friends to pray in secret, and the Quran shows him praying. Who hears you, and how far away?

Part 1 of 3

﴿قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ٱللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَآ أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَءَاخِرِنَا وَءَايَةً مِّنكَ ۖ وَٱرْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Said Jesus, the son of Mary, "O Allāh, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers."

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:114

Translation

Give us today our daily bread.

Original · Ancient Greek

τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον δὸς ἡμῖν σήμερον·

the Gospel (Matthew) · 6:11

World English Bible

His friends ask him how to pray. He gives them a few lines, and every line goes upward: to the One in heaven, for bread, for forgiveness, for rescue. He adds that a person can go into a room, shut the door and speak in secret. This is direct prayer. In the verse he prays too: his friends ask for a table from heaven, and he lifts the request to his Lord and theirs. In both scenes, food is asked of God.

A question for you

When you say the words he taught, who do you feel is hearing them?

If you sayThe Father
ThenThen you are doing what the prayer itself does. Notice how directly the words go to the One who hears them, and what he said about the room and the shut door.
If you sayJesus himself
ThenMany Christians speak to Jesus with love and would not want to stop. He also gave this prayer for you to say with him. Look at where his own eyes go in the verse.
If you sayGod, and I do not divide it further
ThenMany pray this way, whatever they were taught. The verse has nothing to add to that plain turning. One question remains: what would you say to Him in that room?

Part 2 of 3

﴿مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَمَرْتَنِى بِهِۦٓ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبَّكُمْ ۚ وَكُنتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَّا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ ۖ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِى كُنتَ أَنتَ ٱلرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَأَنتَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

I said not to them except what You commanded me - to worship Allāh, my Lord and your Lord. And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them; but when You took me up, You were the Observer over them, and You are, over all things, Witness.

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:117

Translation

If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself. He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

Original · Ancient Greek

ἐάν τις θέλῃ τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ ποιεῖν, γνώσεται περὶ τῆς διδαχῆς πότερον ἐκ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ἢ ἐγὼ ἀπʼ ἐμαυτοῦ λαλῶ. ὁ ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ λαλῶν τὴν δόξαν τὴν ἰδίαν ζητεῖ· ὁ δὲ ζητῶν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ πέμψαντος αὐτὸν οὗτος ἀληθής ἐστιν καὶ ἀδικία ἐν αὐτῷ οὐκ ἔστιν.

the Gospel (John) · 7:17-18

World English Bible

What a person does in his worst hour shows whom he trusts. In the Gospels, on the night of his arrest, Jesus goes apart, falls on his face and calls on his Father. In the verse he speaks to God again, saying he told people only what he was commanded: worship God, my Lord and your Lord. The two scenes share a shape. The one his followers love most is himself calling on God, and points others to do the same.

A question for you

What do you make of the fact that Jesus himself prayed?

If you sayHe prayed as a man, and he is one with the Father
ThenThat is the Church's classic answer, held with long care. It also means that when you pray as he prayed, you stand where his humanity stood: before God, asking. The verse keeps that stance.
If you sayTo show me how to pray
ThenThen his prayer is your pattern. A pattern is followed by doing the same thing: turning to the one he turned to.
If you sayI have never thought about it
ThenFew people do. Some things are so familiar we stop seeing them. Read his words in the verse again: whom does he name as his Lord, before he names yours?

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:186

Translation

Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 145:18

World English Bible

People look for someone to speak for them when the one they need seems far away, unaware or unwilling, or when they feel unworthy to come close. The verse answers each fear: God is near, He answers, and it calls those who ask simply My servants. Notice the grammar. When people ask about other things the Prophet is usually told to say the answer. Here God answers at once. None of this stops your friends praying for you. It says your own words reach Him.

A question for you

If you spoke directly to God tonight, what would your first sentence be?

The same in the other books

Translation

קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

World English Bible

Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

Αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν· ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε· κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν. πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.
